summary: Net reduction made mostly by deleting whole optional sentences and two short exchanges. The essential beats and all eight protected excerpts are kept. Tuppence's mock-promotion biography loses its framing and secondary months. The order scene, Tommy's suit, the Elizabethan gloss, the hostel location and several tag sentences are removed. One Tommy exchange is merged after an intervening Tuppence line was cut. The text has not been recounted here; the intended reduction is roughly 320–330 words.
